meta.title: AI Enhancement Center
meta.description: AI enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness: visual management of MCP servers and skills (the "MCP & Skills" settings page), subagent roles & model pools, automatic retry (provider policies + vendor-expression rules + cross-restart monitor), and per-session service-process panels with auto-registration.

mcp.tools.title: "{name}" tools

mcp.import.title: Paste MCP config
mcp.import.hint: Paste a JSON config (standard mcpServers format, a single server object, or a bare list).
mcp.import.sync.title: Sync MCP config from other agents
mcp.import.sync.hint: Auto-detects Claude Code, Codex, zcode, and Cursor MCP configs on this machine; checked items are imported (same-name overwritten).

subagents.pool.importAll.empty: No syncable models on the settings page

retry.needRestart: Auto retry needs the updated host module: fully quit and restart DeepSeek Harness (not just a page refresh), then retry.
retry.hint: Policies are the built-in dsh-llm-retry executor's per-provider config (effective on the next request); rules are matched by this plugin ahead of the executor and auto-retry with the wait extracted from the vendor error.
retry.aiHint: The session AI can also build retry rules itself with the read_retry_state / test_retry_rule / write_retry_rules tools.

policy.resetConfirm: Restore the default retry policy for this provider?
policy.notEditable: This route is not editable (no settings namespace)
policy.alwaysWarn: Always mode retries every failure without limit (including auth and quota errors); each retry re-bills input tokens. Waits can be cancelled with the stop button.
policy.mode.help: normal = bounded retries (failure ends the turn once exhausted); always = retry every failure until success/cancel.
policy.maxRetries.help: Maximum retries (normal mode) for retryable failure codes.
policy.retryableCodes.help: Which failure codes are worth retrying (comma-separated). The default five suffice; quota-class codes (QUOTA) need to be listed here and paired with an expression rule.
policy.backoffInit.help: Milliseconds to wait before the first retry; doubles each attempt up to the cap.
policy.backoffMax.help: Ceiling for exponential backoff in ms; a provider Retry-After beyond this makes normal mode give up (always mode falls back to local backoff).
policy.backoffJitter.help: Jitter ratio between 0 and 1, so concurrent sessions don't retry in lockstep.

rules.empty: No rules yet. Import a built-in vendor preset in one click, or create a custom rule.
rules.presetsHint: One-click import of common vendor limit/rate-error rules; freely editable after import.

field.name: Rule name
field.codes: Limit to failure codes (comma-separated, empty = all)
field.flags.help: i = case-insensitive (most common; matches Rate and rate alike); m = multiline (^ and $ match each line); combine like im; empty = case-sensitive. Do not use g (global flag is meaningless here and rejected).
field.name.help: Display only — used in listings and the monitor; never matched.
field.when.help: The regex body only, no surrounding slashes. Example: usage\s+limit\s+reached. Common syntax: \d+ digits, \s* any whitespace, . any char, [abc] char set, ( ) capture group (referenced by "Capture group"), | alternation, {0,40} repeat range, \S+ non-space run. A hit on the error text triggers this rule; rules are evaluated in list order, first hit wins.
field.providers.help: Only try this rule for failures on these provider routes, e.g. magpie-anthropic, magpie. Empty = all providers.
field.codes.help: Pre-filter on the harness-normalized failure code before the regex runs. Common: RATE_LIMIT, QUOTA (allowance used up), PI_AI_ERROR (unclassifiable gateway errors, common with relays), SERVER, TIMEOUT. Empty = no filter.
field.waitKind.help: Where to read "how long to wait" from the error: the Retry-After header / an English duration in the text / a Chinese duration / an absolute reset time / a Unix timestamp / JSON fields / a clock time.
field.tz.help: Vendor reset times often carry no zone (Zhipu/bigmodel write Beijing time); this tells the extractor which zone to parse them in. +08:00 is UTC+8.
field.defaultMs.help: Fallback wait when the provider sent no Retry-After. 10000 = 10 seconds.
field.fixedMs.help: The constant wait before every retry — it reads nothing from the error text and ignores the provider Retry-After. 60000 = 1 minute. Values below 1 second are raised to 1 second.
field.group.help: N means extract the wait from the text captured by the Nth ( ) group (counting from 1). Empty = scan the whole error text.
field.maxRetries.help: How many timed retries this rule may trigger within one conversation turn; 0 = retry forever; beyond that the built-in policy takes over. Resets when the turn ends.
field.clampMs.help: Ceiling for a single wait of this rule (a guardrail against absurdly large extractions). Empty = the global cap. 21600000 = 6 hours, 86400000 = 24 hours (maximum).
field.enabled.help: Disabled rules are kept but never matched.

wait.duration-cn: Chinese duration (请 1 分钟后重试)

rules.testHint: Paste a real vendor error (or use a preset sample) and see whether it matches and the wait it extracts.
rules.clampHint: Default ceiling for every rule's wait; rules may override it (≤24h).

monitor.persistHint: Recent events survive restarts (last 100, including failures that scheduled no retry); in-flight waits die with the host.

reason.no-rules: no rules configured (import or create one)
reason.no-match: no rule matched — kernel default policy takes over
reason.cancelled: wait cancelled: turn aborted (stop / model switch / config reload)
